results.title: Kushner to visit Israel after Netanyahu rejects Gaza Board of Peace plan
results.description: Visit to address Israeli opposition to plan for Hamas to disarm, Israel to withdraw from Gaza, board official says.

results.title: San Antonio-area families take Ten Commandments classroom fight toward Supreme Court
results.description: Families tied to Alamo Heights ISD and Comal ISD are among more than two dozen Texas families challenging the state's Ten Commandments classroom law.

results.title: PM Shehbaz briefs President Zardari on Pak-Saudi-Turkiye defence pact
results.description: Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif called on President Asif Ali Zardari in Islamabad on Friday and briefed him on a recently signed defence pact between Pakistan, Saudi Arabia and Turkiye, according to a statement issued by the Presidency.
